color: rgb(74, 47, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
L1_PROBABLE - caller ID matched
name on screen, policy details LOCKED

div.style: color: rgb(51, 51, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
brief shows action 0:
ยืนยันตัวตนผู้ติดต่อก่อนให้ข้อมูลกรมธรรม์

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
agent asks an OPEN question
ขอทราบชื่อผู้ติดต่อด้วยค่ะ

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
never ask a leading question.
'ใช่คุณ X ไหมคะ' both leaks that the number
belongs to them AND is weaker verification -
anyone can answer yes.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
L3_VERIFIED
full disclosure
brief re-renders as v2

div.style: color: rgb(92, 26, 19) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
L0 + rejected id recorded
nothing re-proposes them
feeds a data-quality signal:
usually a recycled mobile number

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
context VISIBLE (which policy)
disclosure STILL LOCKED
+ playbook step: check authority to act

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
why a third button exists. A daughter calling
about her father is neither confirmed nor wrong.
Forced into a binary the agent presses Confirmed,
and the audit log now says the policyholder was
verified. The binary manufactures a false record.

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
disclosure audit log
what was asked, what was shown, when
